title: QXO, Inc. 8-K Filing — Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement (Merger with TopBuild Corp.)
summary: QXO, Inc. entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger on April 18, 2026 to acquire TopBuild Corp. through a two-step merger structure. TopBuild shareholders will receive either $505.00 in cash per share or 20.200 QXO shares per TopBuild share, subject to proration with a 45% cash / 55% stock maximum allocation.
key_points: QXO, Inc. and TopBuild Corp. executed a Merger Agreement dated April 18, 2026
Merger structure involves two successive mergers: Titanium Merger Sub merges into TopBuild, followed by TopBuild merging into Forward Merger Sub
TopBuild shareholders may elect cash consideration of $505.00 per share or stock consideration of 20.200 QXO shares per TopBuild share
Maximum proration: up to 45% of TopBuild shares convert to cash, up to 55% convert to QXO stock (QXO may increase stock allocation at its discretion)
Both boards unanimously approved the merger agreement
QXO is a Delaware corporation headquartered in Greenwich, CT; TopBuild is also a Delaware corporation
why_it_matters: This is a significant M&A transaction in the building materials/services sector. TopBuild shareholders face a choice between cash and QXO stock with potential proration adjustments. The deal terms and exchange ratio ($505 cash or 20.2 QXO shares implied ~$505 valued at QXO's stock price) are relevant for assessing deal spreads and arbitrage positioning in TopBuild shares.
